instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to dream in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to dream</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.b: My brother ((dreams)) of becoming a policeman.
atoms.sound: My brother dreams of becoming a policeman.

atoms.b: When he was still a little boy, he ((dreamt)) of being a hairdresser.
atoms.sound: When he was still a little boy, he dreamt of being a hairdresser.

atoms.b: But since he was 14 years old, he has always ((dreamt)) of being a police officer.
atoms.sound: But since he was 14 years old, he has always dreamt of being a police officer.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to feed in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to feed</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: We always feed our cows hay.
Last week, a guest fed one of our cows an avocado.
atoms.b: Last week, a guest ((fed)) one of our cows an avocado.

atoms.sound: Since avocados are poisonous for cows, we have fed it some medication.
atoms.b: Since avocados are poisonous for cows, we have ((fed)) it some medication.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to fly in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to fly</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: My mother works as a pilot and therefore flies a lot.
atoms.b: My mother works as a pilot and therefore ((flies)) a lot.

atoms.sound: Last summer, she flew a plane to Australia, which took over 20 hours.
atoms.b: Last summer, she ((flew)) a plane to Australia, which took over 20 hours.

atoms.sound: She has flown a helicopter before as well.
atoms.b: She has ((flown)) a helicopter before as well.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to lie (liegen) in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to lie</voice>, im Sinne von liegen, in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: My cat lies down after every meal.
atoms.b: My cat ((lies)) down after every meal.

atoms.sound: Yesterday, she lay down in my lap, which was very unusual.
atoms.b: Yesterday, she ((lay)) down in my lap, which was very unusual.

atoms.sound: Ever since we got our cat, she has lain down in her favourite spot by the window.
atoms.b: Ever since we got our cat, she has ((lain)) down in her favourite spot by the window.

instruction.text: Ordne jedem Infinitiv die passenden Formen des <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>simple past</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>past participle</voice> zu.

atoms.sound: to dream. dreamt or dreamed. dreamt or dreamed.

hint.text:
Im britischen Englisch wird als simple past und past participle von to dream vor allem dreamt verwendet.
Im amerikanischen Englisch wird eher dreamed verwendet.

Im amerikanischen Englisch wird eher <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>dreamed</voice> verwendet.
